verdict.rationale: The evidence pack covers login methods, MFA, SSO, RBAC, Organizations, machine-to-machine flows, and AI-agent token handling, but contains no documentation of session expiry configuration, refresh-token session renewal for end-user sessions, or server-side forced session revocation for a compromised session. Token Vault language (auth0-docs-89) refers to third-party API tokens for AI agents, not end-user session lifecycle control.
